headline: Growth accelerates, but a one-time gain distorts profit
summary_short: Revenue rose to $119.8B (+24.2% y/y), led by Google Cloud (+82% y/y) and Search; operating income grew 30.4% y/y to $40.8B. Net income surged to $112.2B, driven almost entirely by other income/expense rising to $98.0B on unrealized equity gains, not operating performance.
summary_long: Revenue reached $119.8B (+24.2% y/y, +9.0% q/q), led by Google Services (+15% y/y: Search +$9.1B, YouTube ads +$1.3B) and Google Cloud (+82% y/y, aided by newly-started TPU-system revenue recognition). Operating income grew 30.4% y/y to $40.8B; operating margin slipped 2.1ppt q/q to 34.0% as G&A absorbed a disclosed $1.5B charge tied to an unnamed legal matter. Net income of $112.2B and diluted EPS of $9.11 were driven almost entirely by other income/expense rising to $98.0B, mainly a $77.4B net unrealized gain on a non-marketable equity investment plus $21.4B on marketable equities, not operations. Cash rose to $55.9B and equity to $640.5B after a $49.6B capital raise; no share buybacks occurred this quarter.
